message: 新任カラメル係出動！

name: Synn
message: 「Who knew everyday duties were this easy!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, KiraFes is over now, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's definitely part of it, but everyone's skills improving is another reason.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「This is what you call shedding a layer of skin, isn't it.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It is a linguistic vestige from when humans used to molt in order to grow bigger, yes?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Somehow, I get the vague feeling I am being looked down upon. Hmph, hmph.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ahem. Come to think of it, I haven't seen those three around.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Those three?」

name: Ria
message: 「Could you mean... the Demon folks?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, if you mean them--」

name: Synn
message: 「Azel!?」
Why is Azel here when she was supposed to be absent today?

name: Nanaka
message: 「Are you sure you're okay to come to the academy?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Just as I thought, Azel-san is a delinquent!」

name: Misa
message: 「A delinquent?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, she is always ditching class, so I guess you wouldn't be wrong?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「If it is bad for her to come to the academy, then it must be 'house arrest'! It is punishment for ditching class. A delinquent.」

name: Ria
message: 「Listen, Lolotte-chan. Did the thought that she was out sick and might not be well enough to show up not cross your mind?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Ooh. The scales have fallen from my rococo eyes. As expected of someone who isn't just big boobs for show.」

name: Misa
message: 「L-Lolotte-san, how vulgar! Big Sister is splendid regardless of things like that.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, Synn! Don't look at your senior's chest!」

name: Synn
message: 「I didn't look! Anyway, Azel, are you over your cold now?」
Azel silently held out the digital camera to me.

name: Synn
message: 「Did you come all the way here just to return it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Tomorrow would've been fine, you know.」
For some reason, Azel turned her face away and muttered.

name: Azel
message: 「...Giving it back.」

name: Synn
message: 「Mind if I take a quick look?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Whatever.」
Taking the digital camera from Azel, I connected it to my laptop.
I could view them on the camera, sure, but I wanted to see them on a bigger screen.
Transfer... There, all set.

name: Synn
message: 「You sure took a lot.」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
The dates on the photo data... Some are from yesterday, and some from today.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Let me see too!」
I hurriedly switched the data view from details to thumbnails.

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you hiding! Hogging it all to yourself isn't fair!」

name: Synn
message: 「I just switched it to thumbnail view.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. It's Shina-oba! And Tame-san too!」
Nanaka's hand snatched the mouse from me and clicked. Opened.
A scene of Shina-oba showing off what she calls "the truth" to the neighborhood ladies displayed in full screen.

name: Lolotte
message: 「They look identical. It's almost as if the real people were standing right in front of us.」

name: Misa
message: 「Of course they do, they're photographs.」

name: Ria
message: 「Still, I think they're great photos.」
I stole a glance at Azel's face. She was looking away. Maybe she was embarrassed about people seeing the pictures she took.
So Azel didn't come to school because she was too absorbed in taking photos.
She must have really liked it.

name: Synn
message: 「Ria-senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「What is it? Go ahead and ask big sis anything.」

name: Synn
message: 「I feel like there used to be a recorder position in the Student Council. What's the status on that right now?」
Ria-senpai tilted her head cutely.

name: Ria
message: 「For each event, a committee member handles it on the spot, and year-round the photography club fills in, so the position just disappeared before anyone noticed.」
Ria-senpai smiled brightly and continued.

name: Ria
message: 「An official recorder is supposed to be appointed at the start of our term, so we can't assign one now, but since there isn't an official recorder at the moment--」

name: Ria
message: 「We can apply the Student Council rule stating that if there's no recorder for any reason, the Student Council President can appoint an acting recorder.」

name: Synn
message: 「Thank you very much.」
I called out to Azel, who was looking away.

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Azel. Did you like the digital camera?」

name: Azel
message: 「...Whatever.」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen. There's a position on the Student Council called the recorder.」

name: Synn
message: 「The job is to document our events and daily life at the academy, so why don't you give it a tr--」

name: Azel
message: 「I refuse.」

name: Synn
message: 「If you take the post, you get to use that digital camera the whole time you're an officer, you know.」

name: Azel
message: 「Really?!」

name: Synn
message: 「You all saw the photos Azel took too, right? What do you think about having Azel become the Student Council's recorder? I think she's perfect for it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I see. That's my childhood friend for you.」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What's that supposed to mean? Even I thought of something that simple.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Every sore loser says that afterward.」

name: Misa
message: 「What did you say?!」

name: Ria
message: 「Looks like everyone agrees. And of course, I do too.」

name: Synn
message: 「What do you say, Azel?」
Azel looked at the digital camera, then tore her gaze away from it.

name: Azel
message: 「I... I refuse.」

name: Synn
message: 「You don't need to overthink it. Just take pictures however you like, same as during KiraFes.」

name: Synn
message: 「Even the digital camera would want to be used by someone who likes it.」
I pressed the digital camera into Azel's hand.
It was a small hand.

name: Azel
message: 「I-I refuse!」

name: Synn
message: 「The reason we didn't have a recorder is because this digital camera was waiting for you, Azel.」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm counting on you from now on, Azel.」

name: Azel
message: 「...I'll only take pictures of what I feel like.」

name: Synn
message: 「That's fine with me.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'll only take pictures of things I like.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Do that.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Then, fine.」

name: Helena
message: 「Now that that's settled, Crusaders, roll out!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-Where did you come from!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Roll out... Are Demons causing trouble?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「A Demon infiltrated along with the Chairwoman! Having our secret base discovered puts us in a pinch! How exciting.」

name: Misa
message: 「What's so exciting about it. Besides, that kid is Tinun, isn't she.」

name: Ria
message: 「So this place was a secret base... My heart's pounding.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey! Tinun! What are you doing slacking off from work!」

name: Ria
message: 「Work?」

name: Tinun
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, hmm... Whaaat. A Demon is rampaging at Yuugiri-an!?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What did you say!」

name: Helena
message: 「Everyone understands the situation, right?」

name: Helena
message: 「'Roll out!'」

name: Everyone
message: 「Yes, ma'am.」

name: Synn
message: 「Wanna come too, Azel?」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going home.」

name: Synn
message: 「There might be a photo op.」

name: Azel
message: 「I'm going.」
Inside the shop, where disposable chopsticks are inexplicably scattered everywhere, Nanaka's old man with a kitchen knife and a demon are glaring each other down!
It's about two sizes larger than the demons of the Delicious Food Squad.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Whoa. Looks pretty tough.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「The treasurer's father certainly is muscular.」

name: Misa
message: 「Not him!」

name: Azel
message: 「...Nice shot.」

name: Misa
message: 「Aah, Mochimochi!」
Up on the household altar, Mochimochi was collapsed, seemingly taken down by the demon.

name: Jangara
message: 「Eee.」

name: Synn
message: 「He says he's just slacking off on the job and sleeping.」

name: Misa
message: 「Phew...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, thank goodness... Wait, no! That little punk, I'm docking this from his pay!」

name: Ria
message: 「Um... what's going on here?」

name: Synn
message: 「All three of them work at Yuugiri-an.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「They're actually pretty hard workers. Except for one of 'em.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Destroy it already.」

name: Riesling
message: 「Shall I snipe it?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hold on a second. Hey, you. Why are you rampaging?」

name: Ringer
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaat? You weren't rampaging? You were just playing an instrument?」

name: Misa
message: 「An instrument?」

name: Ringer
message: 「Eee.」

name: Synn
message: 「He apparently thinks disposable chopsticks are a musical instrument. He says he liked the snappy 'crack' sound they make when you split them.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hey, come on now.」

name: Ria
message: 「So it wasn't a dine-and-dash.」

name: Ringer
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「He says he only asked if there were any that made different pitches, and when he got yelled at, he lost his temper.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I see. I understand. When I saw a CD for the first time, I ended up throwing it without thinking, too. It's the same thing.」

name: Ria
message: 「Is it... really the same?」

name: Ringer
message: 「Eee!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even if he tells me this shop's are defective and to hand over ones with different pitches... there aren't any with different pitches.」

name: Ringer
message: 「Eek!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, he's surprised.」

name: Synn
message: 「They're not instruments in the first place. They're tableware.」

name: Ringer
message: 「Eee.」

name: Misa
message: 「He looks pretty dejected.」
Nanaka's old man lowered his kitchen knife and looked at me.
Even I, who've known him for a long time, have never seen Nanaka's old man speak.
Yet for some reason, we communicate eye-to-eye.
'Thanks, Synn-kun. He wouldn't listen to a word I said'
'It can't be helped. You don't speak the same language, after all'
Hmm. I get it. I actually get it. Even I find it weird.
'You're so dependable, Synn-kun. Take over Yuugiri-an, my daughter included'
'Oh, stop joking around'
...Are we really communicating?

name: Ringer
message: 「Eee.」

name: Misa
message: 「He seems to be reflecting on what he did. I wonder if he's saying, 'What have I done!'」

name: Synn
message: 「Mostly right, but slightly off.」

name: Misa
message: 「How so?」

name: Synn
message: 「He says, 'For a musician like me to mistake tableware for an instrument--I'm the worst!'」

name: Misa
message: 「His remorse is pointed in a subtly wrong direction.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「So even Demons have musicians, huh.」

name: Ria
message: 「We understand the situation now, and he seems to be sorry too, so... Synn-kun, what should we do?」

name: Azel
message: 「Destroy him.」
I looked at the old man.
'Different upbringings lead to misunderstandings. Let's handle this peacefully'

name: Synn
message: 「Then how about we do this?」
